Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, d As Worksheet, o As Worksheet, ch As Object, co As Object, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set d = wb.Worksheets(1): d.Name = "Data"
    Set o = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=d): o.Name = "Other": d.Activate
    d.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    d.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    d.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    Set co = d.ChartObjects.Add(300, 100, 300, 200): Set ch = co.Chart
    ch.SetSourceData d.Range("A1:C4"), xlColumns
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.Delete
    Case 1
        r = ch.Delete
    Case 2
        ch.Delete: r = ch.Name
    Case 3
        ch.Parent.Delete: r = ch.Name
    Case 4
        co.Delete: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 5
        ch.Delete: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 6
        ch.Delete: r = co.Name
    Case 7
        d.ChartObjects(1).Chart.Delete: r = d.Shapes.Count
    Case 8
        ch.Refresh
    Case 9
        r = ch.Refresh
    Case 10
        d.Range("B2").Value = 9: ch.Refresh: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values()(1)
    Case 11
        ch.Calculate
    Case 12
        r = TypeName(ch.ChartObjects)
    Case 13
        r = ch.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 14
        r = ch.ChartObjects().Count
    Case 15
        r = TypeName(ch.ChartObjects(1))
    Case 16
        r = TypeName(ch.Shapes)
    Case 17
        r = ch.Shapes.Count
    Case 18
        ch.Shapes.AddShape 1, 1, 1, 50, 50: r = ch.Shapes.Count
    Case 19
        ch.Shapes.AddShape 1, 1, 1, 50, 50: r = ch.Shapes(1).Name
    Case 20
        ch.Shapes.AddTextbox 1, 1, 1, 50, 50: r = ch.Shapes(1).Type
    Case 21
        r = TypeName(ch.OLEObjects)
    Case 22
        r = ch.OLEObjects.Count
    Case 23
        r = TypeName(ch.Hyperlinks)
    Case 24
        r = ch.Hyperlinks.Count
    Case 25
        r = TypeName(ch.Evaluate("Data!A1"))
    Case 26
        r = ch.Evaluate("Data!A1").Value
    Case 27
        r = ch.Evaluate("1+2")
    Case 28
        r = ch.Evaluate("A1")
    Case 29
        r = TypeName(ch.Evaluate("A1"))
    Case 30
        r = ch.Evaluate("Series1")
    Case 31
        r = TypeName(ch.Evaluate("Legend"))
    Case 32
        r = ch.Evaluate("SUM(Data!B2:B4)")
    Case 33
        r = [Data!B2]
    Case 34
        r = TypeName(ch.Location(xlLocationAutomatic))
    Case 35
        r = TypeName(ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Other")): r = r & d.ChartObjects.Count & o.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 36
        r = TypeName(ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Shown")): r = r & d.ChartObjects.Count & wb.Charts.Count & wb.Sheets.Count
    Case 37
        r = TypeName(ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet)): r = r & wb.Charts(1).Name
    Case 38
        ch.Location xlLocationAsObject, "Nowhere"
    Case 39
        ch.Location xlLocationAsObject, "Data": r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 40
        ch.Location 9
    Case 41
        ch.Location xlLocationAsObject
    Case 42
        ch.Move
    Case 43
        ch.Move After:=o
    Case 44
        ch.Copy
    Case 45
        ch.Copy After:=o
    Case 46
        r = wb.Charts.Add.Name
    Case 47
        wb.Charts.Add: r = wb.Charts(1).Parent.Name
    Case 48
        ch.Resize
    Case 49
        ch.Resize 10, 10
    Case 50
        r = TypeName(ch.Walls)
    Case 51
        r = TypeName(ch.Floor)
    Case 52
        r = TypeName(ch.BackWall)
    Case 53
        r = TypeName(ch.SideWall)
    Case 54
        r = ch.Walls.Name
    Case 55
        r = ch.Floor.Name
    Case 56
        ch.ChartType = xl3DColumnClustered: r = TypeName(ch.Walls)
    Case 57
        ch.ChartType = xl3DColumnClustered: r = ch.Floor.Name
    Case 58
        ch.ChartType = xl3DColumnClustered: r = ch.BackWall.Name
    Case 59
        ch.ChartType = xl3DColumnClustered: r = ch.SideWall.Name
    Case 60
        ch.ChartType = xl3DColumnClustered: r = ch.Walls.Name
    Case 61
        r = TypeName(ch.Axes(xlValue).Border)
    Case 62
        r = ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.LineStyle
    Case 63
        r = ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.Color
    Case 64
        r = ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.Weight
    Case 65
        ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.Color = 255: r = ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.Color
    Case 66
        ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.Weight = xlThick: r = ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.Weight
    Case 67
        ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.LineStyle = xlNone: r = ch.Axes(xlValue).Border.LineStyle
    Case 68
        r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    Case 69
        r = TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection(1).LeaderLines)
    Case 70
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).ClearFormats
    Case 71
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).ClearFormats: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 72
        r = ch.ClearToMatchColorStyle
    Case 73
        ch.ClearToMatchColorStyle
    Case 74
        r = TypeName(wb.Charts.Add)
    Case 75
        r = TypeName(wb.Charts.Add.ChartObjects)
    Case 76
        r = wb.Charts.Add.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 77
        r = wb.Charts.Add.Shapes.Count
    Case 78
        wb.Charts.Add.Delete: r = wb.Charts.Count
    Case 79
        wb.Charts.Add.Refresh
    Case 80
        r = TypeName(wb.Charts.Add.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Other")): r = r & wb.Charts.Count & o.ChartObjects.Count
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = d.ChartObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.ChartObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Charts.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Sheets.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ActiveSheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = d.Shapes.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(ch.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.Parent.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
